title: Event envelope (CloudEvents 1.0 style)
description: Every event on ctx.bus, in the outbox, on Pub/Sub and on webhooks uses this envelope. Events carry ids and codes, never PII; consumers fetch details through the API. On Pub/Sub binary mode the attributes are ce-specversion, ce-type, ce-source, ce-id, ce-time, ce-subject and tenantid (CloudEvents extension names are lowercase).

id.description: Unique event id (evt_...). Consumers must be idempotent on id.

subject.description: claimId for claim.* events; tenantId for tenant.* events.

correlationId.description: Request or intake session that started the chain.

causationId.description: Id of the event that caused this one.
